claim_domain: Finite connected positively weighted undirected bipartite graphs with at least two vertices; unforced discrete sine phase coupling on a torus, transverse to global rotation.
integrity: The stated universal theorem is supported by an analytical proof; finite numerical computations are corroborative only. Independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Global period-two exclusion only at or below the sharp step threshold; local existence and stability of a checkerboard period-two branch immediately above it; local generic critical relaxation. Not a global attractor or higher-period classification. Historical literature priority requires independent inspection of unavailable full primary sources.
title: Sharp two-cycle threshold and critical decay on weighted bipartite phase networks
